name: X-Men Core Reading Order: Silver Age to Claremont
description: The X-Men from their 1963 debut to the year after the Mutant Massacre, in one order: the Lee and Kirby run, Giant-Size X-Men and the Claremont and Cockrum relaunch, the Phoenix, Dark Phoenix and Brood sagas, Days of Future Past, God Loves Man Kills, and the arrival of the New Mutants and X-Factor. Compiled by hand from a reader's outline of Comic Book Herald's guides, read as a reference and re-expressed here, so the order is not derived from Marvel metadata and cannot be checked against it. The Mutant Massacre is read in the crossover's own interleaved order. X-Men #67-93 are left out because all 27 are reprints of issues this order already carries and Marvel holds no metadata for the reprint years. The outline ran out partway through X-Factor's second year, so this stops at X-Factor #23 and reaches neither Fall of the Mutants nor Inferno.
